environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed as part of a Step Functions workflow for document retrieval. The KMS key used for document encryption is a standard AWS KMS CMK (aws/kms symmetric key) with a key policy granting kms:Decrypt to the Lambda execution role without any condition keys. The Step Functions state machine accepts input directly from API Gateway without input transformation. DynamoDB table 'documents' has no row-level security. The Lambda execution role has dynamodb:GetItem on all items in the table.

config.dynamodb_policy: Full GetItem access on documents table
config.api_gateway_auth: Cognito authorizer (validates user is authenticated but does not restrict document_id parameter)
